asset_contract.title: Rigging net
asset_contract.summary: Three shrouds and their ratlines from deadeyes just outboard of a rail node up 4.4 m inboard to under a mast's top (8.45 m). Inboard is -X: starboard nets stand unturned, port nets turned half round. Pivot on the rail node. Ship part hull.rigging_net (node part).
asset_contract.placement: Pivot at the frame node the part hangs on (part pivot offset zero).
asset_contract.materials: Sail_Wood, Sail_Brass, Sail_Iron, Sail_Sail, Sail_Trim, Sail_Rope; ShipDesignsAssetBuilder swaps each for the shared ship material (M_ShipHull, M_ShipEngine, M_ShipIron, M_ShipSail, M_ShipCanvas, M_ShipDeck).
asset_contract.footprint_blocks: One row of blocks at z 0, from the rail (x 0) in to x -4; not solid.
asset_contract.movable_parts: None yet: the cloth is to sway in its material (ART_DIRECTION.md, Motion and life).
